name: Card Payment Data Set Transaction 54
definition: Cancelled card payment transaction to be captured in a batch.

Traceability.name: Traceability
Traceability.definition: Identification of partners involved in the exchange from the merchant to the issuer, with the corresponding timestamp of their exchanges.

Environment.name: Environment
Environment.definition: Data related to the environment of the cancelled transaction captured in batch.

Context.name: Context
Context.definition: Context in which the transaction is performed (payment and sale).

Transaction.name: Transaction
Transaction.definition: Card payment cancellation transaction between an acceptor and an acquirer.
